about: The ground drill (docs/sandbox/TERRAIN-DIGGING.md, 'Sculpting'): what digging gives and what a fill costs. A scoop and a fill are balls of 'scoopRadius' metres at the crosshair, 'reach' metres at most from the eye, one every 'repeatSeconds' while the button is held. 'units' is the units of a carried material per cubic metre, both ways, so digging out and filling in balance. 'ground' is what each terrain material gives when dug; under 'stoneDepth' metres below the surface as built everything is stone. A fill reaches at most 'maxAboveSurface' metres over the surface as built. The tool stops at 'logShare' of the terrain log, so blasts always have room. 'scoops' is for the Scoop parts (CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Scoops'): how hard each kind of ground holds a scoop back against dirt, how many times harder for one that can't cut (full, or pushed any way but edge first), the shortest time between one scoop's bites, the bites a tenth of a second in the whole world, and their share of the log.
